# KaTeX 0.18.7

Self-hosted browser assets from the official npm release of KaTeX 0.18.7.

Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.18.7.tgz

Documentation: https://katex.org/docs/browser.html

Files included: minified renderer, auto-render extension, stylesheet, all referenced font formats, and the upstream MIT license. These files are unmodified.
